comment: Numeric floor manifest (DR-27a). No pinned floor may decrease — tests/guards/numeric-floor-manifest.test.ts enforces this. Each entry pins a floor value AND the number of sites spelling it: the guard requires at least `occurrences` matches of `pattern` in `sourceFile`, so lowering one site out of several is caught. New entries are allowed; raise `floor`/`pattern` (and `occurrences`) deliberately when an assertion is raised.

floors.description: Number of compiled MDS host commands in dist/commands/ (ALL_HOSTS)
Number of _partials/*.mds partial files
DIST_FILES count = ALL_HOSTS (13) + release.md (1); DIST_FILES vs ALL_HOSTS divergence is permanent (SG-13)
Minimum timeout in ms for slow shell-exec tests that call npm run build:mds
Minimum number of subagent_type literal sites across dist+scripts corpus (currently ~66+)
MAX_CHARTER_CHARS = 75% of the 4096-char shell injection cap; orchestrator charter must stay at or below this
Minimum number of DEVFLOW_PLUGINS registry entries
Minimum install-path references in dist/commands/ files

D11 forward guard: posting ops (--body-file / -F body=@) that must reference Comment-sink scrub (D11), from git.md alone (AC-0.8). This is the '>= 8' named in the Phase-0 exit gate; the plugin-count entry above pins a different >= 8 in a different file.
resolveAllAgents() size — every DEVFLOW_PLUGINS agent resolves through the shared resolver (AC-0.7, GAP-07)
Operations indexed from git.md by the seam test's op→section map [DR-24]
Operations with at least one live caller fence. Directions 1 and 2 iterate this map; if it empties, both pass vacuously (the defect this floor exists to make loud).

Entries in issue_capture_contract() checked by the seam test's producer direction — corrected from 5 to 3 after removing ISSUE_ID and ISSUE_URL (c7bff85: no emitted producer in git.md for either name)
git.md line count Phase-0 baseline — a decrease means containment lines were lost (updated from 959 after D4 degradation additions to fetch-issue + fetch-issues-batch)
git.md character count Phase-0 baseline — a decrease means content was removed (updated from 60440 after D4 degradation additions to fetch-issue + fetch-issues-batch)
git.md line count assertion uses >= floor style so growth is allowed but shrinkage below Phase-0 baseline is caught; converted from toBe after production commits grew git.md
git.md char count assertion uses >= floor style so growth is allowed but shrinkage below Phase-0 baseline is caught; converted from toBe after production commits grew git.md
manage-debt archive character cap (60 000 chars) — 4 tests assert this value; lowering one test out of the set is caught
D10 dedup-marker guard: two >= 2 floors in git-agent.test.ts (post-review-summary and post-resolution-summary dedup markers); lowering either site is caught

AC-0.10 containment guard (issue-body): ops wrapping remote issue content in <untrusted-issue-body> — setup-task, fetch-issue, fetch-issues-batch (three ops added in commit 75f13e7). Split from the prior combined predicate to make this assertion non-vacuous on main.

AC-0.10 containment guard (external-thread): ops carrying <external-thread> for review thread bodies — fetch-review-threads, post-resolution-summary, post-wave-report (pre-existing on main, Principle 8 stabilisation).
